profile_text.body:
Appian Corp describes itself as a provider of AI-powered process orchestration for enterprises. Its website states that the Appian platform orchestrates AI agents, systems, and people without replacing existing systems, and that the company has been automating processes for more than 25 years. The site says Appian was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT).

The company's site lists capabilities including process orchestration, AI reliability and control, legacy application modernization with AI, accounts payable and receivable automation, procurement, no-code app building with embedded AI agents, audit workflows, case resolution, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order orchestration, and contract review. It states that onboarding can be cut by up to 50% and that Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world's largest organizations.

Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, trading under ticker APPN with SEC CIK 0001441683. It is also known as APPIAN CORP-A. The company has 152 legal exposure records in Virginia, though no individual court cases are named.
